label: Content Security Policy
value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's CSP header; body remains fixed.

label: Strict Transport Security
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's HSTS header; redirect chain and certificate evidence remain fixed.

label: Frame options
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's X-Frame-Options header.

label: Content-type options
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's X-Content-Type-Options header.

label: Referrer Policy
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's Referrer-Policy header.

label: Cross-Origin Resource Policy
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's CORP header.

label: Cross-Origin Opener Policy
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's COOP header; it affects releases that score that test.

label: Cross-Origin Embedder Policy
modifies: Replace the selected auto response's COEP header; it affects releases that score that test.

label: Cookie flags
modifies: In the active remediate.mjs implementation, set secure=true, httpOnly=true and sameSite=strict on every existing session-jar cookie; an empty jar stays empty. Earlier actions.mjs prototype instead adds a fixed synthetic Set-Cookie header.
